ce_bugs.text: Public group members page is silently truncated to 50 members: the server hard-caps at limit 50 and the public members route fetches once with no pagination UI in members.hbs, so end users can never see more than 50 members
usernames.split(",") in admin/groups_controller.rb add_members raises NoMethodError (500) if the usernames param is sent as an array, e.g. by an API client using usernames[]=a&usernames[]=b
The usernames input is not cleared after addMembers, so a second click of 'Add' re-submits the same users

Unbounded client-controlled limit and offset on the public group members endpoint: limit is not clamped to a maximum and offset is not clamped to >= 0, allowing clients to defeat pagination and trigger unbounded queries/materialization (and a negative offset causes a 500)
No bound on the size of the usernames payload in add_members, allowing a single request to carry tens of thousands of usernames and making the N+1 cost unbounded

findMembers clamps offset using possibly-stale user_count before the request, causing wrong computed offsets in findMembers and admin-group next/previous actions, leading to wasted duplicate fetches and wrong-page UX

Breaking response-shape change on public GET /groups/:group_id/members: previously returned a bare serialized array, now returns { members: [...], meta: { total, limit, offset } }, breaking external consumers that map over the array, with no versioning or deprecation path

Public group members page is silently truncated to 50 members with no pagination controls added to the members template (unlike the admin template which got next/previous actions), a functional regression for large groups

Admin API contract break: create and update in admin/groups_controller.rb now read flat params (params[:name], params[:visible], params[:alias_level]) instead of nested group[...] params, breaking external API consumers that POST {group: {name: ...}}

Removed PATCH membership API (update_patch handling params[:changes][:add]/[:delete]) and PUT group[usernames] full-replacement logic, but PATCH and PUT still route to update and return success_json while silently no-oping membership changes

Pagination off-by-one in totalPages computed in admin-group.js.es6: Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1 overcounts when user_count is a multiple of limit, causing navigation to an empty page and showLast never being true on the real last page so the next arrow is never disabled
After removing the last member of a page, the stale offset is not backed up to the previous page, causing findMembers to return an empty member list
remove_member can raise ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound (unhandled 500) when the user_id is not currently a member, due to has_many :through delete with no pre-check
Public members endpoint accepts unbounded limit (e.g. limit=1000000) that can serialize the entire user table, and unvalidated values allow arbitrary limits on public endpoints
Public members endpoint accepts unvalidated negative offset which produces invalid SQL on Postgres, causing a 500

No guard against concurrent/out-of-order member fetches: pagination buttons aren't disabled while fetching and there's no request sequencing, so rapid clicks can leave displayed list and pagination state inconsistent
Controller specs call actions directly with hand-fed group_id, bypassing routing and masking the route param-name mismatch; a request or routing spec would have caught it
New frontend pagination logic untested and totalPages = floor(user_count / limit) + 1 has an off-by-one producing an extra empty page when user_count is an exact multiple of limit

Pagination math is computed in three places with three sources of truth (controller computeds, controller next/previous actions, model findMembers re-clamping, plus server meta), allowing them to disagree

totalPages off-by-one: Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1 returns an extra page when user_count is exactly divisible by limit (100 users / 50 per page shows 3 pages and 'next' navigates to an empty page); should be Math.floor((user_count - 1) / limit) + 1
findMembers has an inconsistent return contract: returns undefined when group name is empty but a Promise otherwise, breaking any caller that chains .then()
findMembers addresses the group by mutable user-editable name instead of id, causing 404s or wrong-group fetches after a rename

Duplicated fire-and-forget member loading (model.findMembers() with no rejection handling) in both admin_group_route setupController and group-members route, swallowing failures and leaving the UI silently empty on network errors
Spec 'cannot remove members from automatic groups' uses xhr :put, remove_member but the route is delete, so the test doesn't actually exercise remove_member; it should use xhr :delete

Public group members page silently truncated to 50 members with no pagination controls — limit is unconditionally applied server-side and the public group/members.hbs template has no next/previous UI, hiding members from end users

totalPages computed property in admin-group.js.es6 uses Math.floor(user_count/limit) + 1, producing an off-by-one phantom empty last page when user_count is an exact multiple of limit; should use Math.ceil

group_member.hbs remove link guards on `automatic` but the item template's context is the member (Discourse.User) which has no automatic property, so the guard evaluates falsy and the remove icon is shown on automatic groups, yielding 422 errors when clicked

remove_member executes group.users.delete(user_id) immediately (destroying the join row) before group.save, so if group.save fails afterward the controller reports an error even though the member was already removed, leaving stale UI
remove_member spec uses xhr :put for a DELETE-routed action, exercising the action with the wrong HTTP verb because controller specs bypass routing, hiding the P1 param mismatch

Stale-count race in pagination: next/findMembers clamp offsets against locally cached user_count with no request-sequencing guard, allowing offset == user_count and a permanently empty last page under concurrent mutations or out-of-order promise resolution

mrv_findings.text: Public group members page hard-caps to 50 members with no pagination UI, making members beyond 50 unreachable (regression from old behavior that returned all users)
totalPages calculation uses Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1, producing an off-by-one blank page when user_count is an exact multiple of limit; should use Math.ceil(user_count / limit)
Adding a nonexistent username to a group silently succeeds with no error feedback, so the admin never learns the member wasn't added
Removing the last member on the last page leaves a stale offset, causing findMembers to query beyond the new total and render an empty page
Add-members input is never cleared after a successful add, leaving stale usernames displayed in the user-selector
The new GET /groups/:name/members JSON contract (members array plus meta.total/limit/offset) has no spec coverage, so meta key drift or ignored pagination params would break all member lists silently

The normal (non-automatic) group update path has no spec coverage after the wire format changed from nested {group: {...}} to flat {name, alias_level, visible} params, so a param-name mismatch between save() and the controller would ship silently

totalPages helper in admin-group.js.es6 uses Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1 which is wrong when user_count is evenly divisible by limit (e.g., 100 members with limit 50 gives 3 pages instead of 2), causing showingLast to never become true, next staying enabled, and the admin landing on a phantom empty page; should use Math.ceil and clamp to (totalPages-1) * limit

GET /groups/:name/members endpoint changed from returning a bare serialized array to returning {members, meta} envelope, a breaking change to a public API contract with no back-compat that will silently break plugins, themes, or external consumers parsing the old array shape

admin_base.scss restyles the Badges admin page via the new .groups, .badges selector, changing badges admin form label weight, field margins, and input widths as an undeclared side effect unrelated to group memberships

admin_base.scss silently strips input/textarea/select { width: 350px } and bold labels from the pre-existing section.details .form-horizontal block by moving them to the new .groups, .badges selector, causing visual regressions in unrelated admin pages rendering section.details
user-selector-autocomplete.raw.hbs and admin-group-selector.hbs contain only whitespace-only re-indentation churn, polluting blame history and inflating the apparent scope of the change

Admin::GroupsController#add_members reports success even when zero usernames matched — typo'd or whitespace-padded usernames are silently dropped, admin sees success, and combined with the TODO'd input clearing there is no feedback loop to tell whether an add actually happened
spec for remove_member uses xhr :put instead of the actual delete route verb, so functional tests bypass routing and the verb/route contract for remove_member has no real coverage

The old spec asserting non-automatic group rename works via PUT :update was deleted, not migrated, leaving the live rename path (group.name = params[:name] if params[:name] && !group.automatic) untested so future regressions in the rename branch ship undetected

Breaking, unversioned API contract change on GET /groups/:name/members: response shape changed from bare JSON array to { members: [...], meta: { total, limit, offset } }, breaking existing consumers with no versioning, deprecation period, or compatibility branch

Removed membership-management API surface silently: get 'users' route deleted with no replacement or 410/redirect, PUT /admin/groups/:id no longer reads group[usernames] (silently ignores it and returns success_json), PATCH .../changes path removed, and automatic-group rejection status changed from 403 to 422
PUT /admin/groups/:id with {group: {usernames: 'a,b'}} now returns 200 success while zero membership changes occur — a silent no-op reported as success

Off-by-one pagination math in admin-group.js.es6: totalPages uses Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1 which produces a phantom page when user_count % limit == 0, and the next action clamps offset to user_count instead of the last page boundary

removeMember in group.js reloads via findMembers() without adjusting offset for the now-smaller member list, causing an empty page, currentPage exceeding totalPages, and both nav arrows rendering enabled
findMembers computes offset = Math.min(user_count, Math.max(offset, 0)) against the pre-response user_count and clamps to user_count rather than a page boundary, producing a misaligned partial page
group_member.hbs gates the remove link on {{#unless automatic}} but the item context is a Discourse.User which has no automatic property, so the remove control shows for automatic group members
removeMember and addMembers have no error handlers, so when the server rejects removal of automatic group members with 422 the failure is completely silent

add_members silently skips unresolvable usernames and never strips whitespace, then returns success_json unconditionally — e.g. ' alice' fails lookup and is skipped without feedback while the response reports success
N+1 query pattern in add_members: usernames.split(',').each issues one User.find_by_username query per username in a loop; should use a single batched User.where(username: list)

findMembers previously returned a promise (Ember.RSVP.resolve([])) when name was empty but now does bare return (undefined, not a promise), breaking any external caller doing group.findMembers().then(...)

limit and offset params on the public GET /groups/:name/members endpoint are completely unclamped — limit=100000000 loads the entire membership table in one request, and a negative offset produces an invalid SQL OFFSET error (500)

No request sequencing in pagination actions: next/previous fire findMembers() without disabling, aborting, or ordering in-flight requests, so the most recent response wins and can leave the header showing one page's offset/user_count while the member list shows different data
Pagination math in admin-group.js.es6 produces a phantom empty last page when user_count is divisible by limit (totalPages off by one, offset clamped to user_count instead of user_count - limit)
Public group members page is silently truncated to 50 members with no pagination controls, a behavioral regression for groups with more than 50 members
Group creation can no longer add initial members in one step; the create-with-usernames workflow and API contract (POST /admin/groups with group[usernames]) was removed
Stale usernames in the admin group controller are never reset on model swap, so typed usernames can leak between groups and be added to the wrong group via model.addMembers
Adding non-existent usernames in add_members silently succeeds with a success toast and no error, and the input is never cleared so a retry re-adds everyone

External admin API contract broken without transition: removed users route, incremental changes add/delete endpoint, and nested group[usernames] payload support cause existing clients to silently no-op or 404
remove_member spec uses xhr :put but the actual route is DELETE, so the test passes regardless of whether the DELETE route exists or is correctly wired
Admin and group-members routes no longer wait for the findMembers promise, so transient AJAX failures render an empty member list with no spinner or error

Unbounded, user-controlled `limit` parameter on the public `/groups/:name/members` endpoint allows bulk user enumeration and memory/CPU exhaustion via large limit values (e.g. limit=100000000), with no maximum cap applied
Negative or zero `limit`/`offset` values from request params are passed directly into ActiveRecord queries without lower-bound validation

`usernames.split(",")` in `Admin::GroupsController#add_members` crashes with NoMethodError (500) when `usernames` is sent as an array, since `params.require` returns an Array which has no `split` method
`params.require(:user_id).to_i` in `Admin::GroupsController#remove_member` crashes with NoMethodError (500) when `user_id` is sent as an array, since Array has no `to_i` method

The primary non-automatic group update path (rename, alias_level change, visible toggle) lost all test coverage: the diff deleted the old 'is able to update group members' test and replaced the .update context with only one test covering the automatic-group edge case, so a regression in the normal-group edit flow would pass the suite green

The remove_member spec calls the action with the wrong HTTP verb (xhr :put instead of DELETE), so controller specs bypass routing and never verify the DELETE route wiring in routes.rb — deleting or breaking the route leaves the spec green while the admin UI remove button 404s

The 'visible' assertion in the .update test cannot fail: the automatic admins group already defaults visible to true, so the assertion passes even if the 'group.visible = params[:visible] == "true"' line were deleted; no test ever sets visible to false, so the string-vs-boolean coercion logic is unverified in either direction

Both new render_json_error error branches in create and update actions have no test that triggers them — no test submits an invalid payload, so the error path and the exact JSON error shape the frontend must handle to un-set disableSave is unverified; a 500 or unparseable shape would leave the admin save button permanently disabled

The non-existent-username branch in the new add_members endpoint (username not found → silently skipped) is untested: the old spec covering this semantics was deleted without being ported, so regressions like raising 500 on unknown username or breaking on whitespace in comma-separated input would go undetected

Routes for add_members/remove_member supply params[:id] but controllers require params[:group_id], so params.require(:group_id) raises ActionController::ParameterMissing and every production add/remove group member request fails
Specs inject group_id directly via xhr :put instead of going through the real routes, so the route/controller param mismatch is never caught by the test suite
The 'cannot remove members from automatic groups' spec uses xhr :put :remove_member (PUT verb) while the route only defines DELETE, so the specs never exercise the actual route/controller contract

Public members endpoint response shape changed from an array to {members, meta} in one step, breaking pre-deploy clients that call result.map() with 'result.map is not a function' and removing the old array-shaped public API with no versioning or overlap window (expand+contract violation)

Admin groups update action silently drops the old group[usernames] payload — pre-deploy admin sessions save membership changes and get a success response while the membership change is discarded, with no dual-read of the old payload shape

GET /admin/groups/:id/users route removed outright with no deprecation or redirect, causing 404s for existing API consumers, and its replacement /groups/:name/members.json is not a drop-in substitution (different identifier and different auth surface)
